name: llama31_8b_vq2_gpqacc128k
description: Codebook position-coverage ablation: gpqacc128k (198 GPQA prompts cycled into 4 x 131072-token sequences) vs the canonical gpqacc64k (8 x 65536). Identical corpus, total token budget (524K), trainer flags, and rotations — the delta isolates RoPE-position coverage of the K-codebook calibration. Comparison target: grid_v2/vq2 (same rotations, gpqacc64k). EXTENDED 2026-07-22: reasoning/code cells added — gpqacc128k becomes the canonical calibration across all experiments (user directive); NIAH cells already complete and skip on rerun.

calibration.k_codebook_recipe: capture_mixed_concat (gpqa-only segments, 4 x 131072 cycled, pool-stride 4) -> train_group_vq_alloc --grouping stratified --allocation flat --bpc 2 --pertoken-norm -> make_fp8 e5m2; built by build_llama_128k_codebook.sh

vq2_128k.notes: only the K codebook differs from grid_v2/vq2

protocol.niah: greedy (T=0), 1 rollout/row, gen cap 128, accuracy = mean RULER string_match over 8 subtasks
protocol.note: reasoning/code cells intentionally omitted — method-insensitive (all quantized methods tie bf16 there), NIAH is where codebook calibration shows
